cases.prompt: Locate the function deciding whether a project-scoped context prompt applies. Explain how explicit workflows and consumer exclusions interact, citing the file and function.

outputs.label: A
outputs.final:
The deciding function is `policy_match` in [context_policy.py](/srv/workspaces/projects/agent-hub/backend/app/services/context_policy.py:82). Prompt delivery reaches it from `_build_prompt_blocks` in [runtime_context.py](/srv/workspaces/projects/agent-hub/backend/app/services/runtime_context.py:1360), after converting each prompt row with `source_policy`.

For a project-scoped prompt, `policy_match` uses `context.project_id` as the target and considers scope matched when that project is in `policy.targets`. It also computes `workflow` as the intersection of `policy.workflows` and `context.workflow_ids`. The first gate is `scope_matches or workflow`, so an explicitly requested workflow can make the prompt apply even when the project scope itself does not match.

Consumer exclusions still win. Immediately after the scope/workflow gate, `policy_match` calls `applicability_matches`; if that fails, it returns `"consumer excluded or does not match targeting"` regardless of workflow match. The exclusion checks live in [applicability.py](/srv/workspaces/projects/agent-hub/backend/app/services/memory/applicability.py:213), including `exclude_consumer_surfaces`, `exclude_consumer_profiles`, `exclude_agent_slugs`, and `exclude_audience_tags`.

The tests pin this interaction in [test_context_governance.py](/srv/workspaces/projects/agent-hub/backend/tests/services/test_context_governance.py:35): `test_security_policy_requires_scope_or_explicit_workflow` shows workflow activation can include the project prompt, while `test_workflow_never_bypasses_consumer_exclusion` shows `exclude_consumer_surfaces=["codex"]` blocks it even with the matching workflow.

cases.prompt: Locate the Runtime Context UI save flow and its server-side stale-update protection. Explain the preview gate and revision check with file/function references.

outputs.label: A
outputs.final:
Read-only only: no files changed, no network, no services.

**UI Save Flow**
The Runtime Context page is [page.tsx](/srv/workspaces/projects/agent-hub/frontend/src/app/runtime-context/page.tsx:5), which mounts `ContextManager`.

In [ContextManager.tsx](/srv/workspaces/projects/agent-hub/frontend/src/components/runtime-context/ContextManager.tsx:32), the editor tracks `edits`, `placements`, and `preview`. It builds the `ContextDraft` with `expected_placement_revision` from the current inventory at [line 162](/srv/workspaces/projects/agent-hub/frontend/src/components/runtime-context/ContextManager.tsx:162). Source edits go through `stage()`, which copies the original source `revision` into `expected_revision` at [line 176](/srv/workspaces/projects/agent-hub/frontend/src/components/runtime-context/ContextManager.tsx:176). Placement edits go through `place()` at [line 193](/srv/workspaces/projects/agent-hub/frontend/src/components/runtime-context/ContextManager.tsx:193).

The preview gate is client-side: `previewChanges()` posts the draft to `/preview` and stores the returned inventory at [line 217](/srv/workspaces/projects/agent-hub/frontend/src/components/runtime-context/ContextManager.tsx:217). `Save reviewed changes` is disabled unless there are staged changes, a preview exists, and `preview.delivery.status === 'ok'` at [line 1018](/srv/workspaces/projects/agent-hub/frontend/src/components/runtime-context/ContextManager.tsx:1018). Any new staged edit or placement clears the preview, forcing a fresh preview before save.

`saveChanges()` posts the same draft to `/save` and only clears the draft after success at [line 222](/srv/workspaces/projects/agent-hub/frontend/src/components/runtime-context/ContextManager.tsx:222). The API helper sends these to `/api/runtime-context/manage/*` in [context-management.ts](/srv/workspaces/projects/agent-hub/frontend/src/lib/api/context-management.ts:125). Backend routes are `/manage/preview` and `/manage/save` in [context_management.py](/srv/workspaces/projects/agent-hub/backend/app/api/context_management.py:40).

**Server Protection**
The server contract is `SourceEdit.expected_revision` and `ContextDraft.expected_placement_revision` in [context_governance.py](/srv/workspaces/projects/agent-hub/backend/app/services/context_governance.py:36). A source revision is `sha256:` plus a semantic hash of `source_snapshot(row)` in [context_policy.py](/srv/workspaces/projects/agent-hub/backend/app/services/context_policy.py:110).

`apply_source_edit()` locks the source row, recomputes `source_revision(row)`, and rejects stale edits with HTTP 409 before mutation if it differs from `expected_revision`: [context_governance.py](/srv/workspaces/projects/agent-hub/backend/app/services/context_governance.py:175).

`apply_draft()` also protects placement edits. It takes the placement-layer advisory lock, snapshots current placements, and compares `semantic_hash(before_placements)` to `expected_placement_revision`; mismatch raises HTTP 409: [context_governance.py](/srv/workspaces/projects/agent-hub/backend/app/services/context_governance.py:267).

Preview uses the real `apply_draft()` path inside a nested transaction, then always rolls back: [context_governance.py](/srv/workspaces/projects/agent-hub/backend/app/services/context_governance.py:317). Save commits only after `apply_draft(..., preview=False)` succeeds and rolls back on error: [context_management.py](/srv/workspaces/projects/agent-hub/backend/app/api/context_management.py:45). So stale changes after preview are caught at save time by the revision checks.

Test evidence: UI save-disabled-before-preview and `expected_revision` payload coverage is in [runtime-context-page.test.tsx](/srv/workspaces/projects/agent-hub/frontend/src/__tests__/runtime-context-page.test.tsx:134); stale save rejection keeps the draft staged at [line 172](/srv/workspaces/projects/agent-hub/frontend/src/__tests__/runtime-context-page.test.tsx:172). Backend stale-source rejection before mutation is in [test_context_governance.py](/srv/workspaces/projects/agent-hub/backend/tests/services/test_context_governance.py:79), and preview rollback / stale old revision behavior is exercised in [test_context_management_transactions.py](/srv/workspaces/projects/agent-hub/backend/tests/integration/test_context_management_transactions.py:68).

**UI Save Flow**
The Runtime Context page renders `ContextManager` from [page.tsx](/srv/workspaces/projects/agent-hub/frontend/src/app/runtime-context/page.tsx:5). `ContextManager` builds one `ContextDraft` with `edits`, `placements`, `expected_placement_revision`, `reason`, and `proposal_id` at [ContextManager.tsx](/srv/workspaces/projects/agent-hub/frontend/src/components/runtime-context/ContextManager.tsx:162).

Source edits are staged by `stage()`, which copies the original source `revision` into `expected_revision` and clears the previous preview at [ContextManager.tsx](/srv/workspaces/projects/agent-hub/frontend/src/components/runtime-context/ContextManager.tsx:176). Placement edits go through `place()` and also clear preview at [ContextManager.tsx](/srv/workspaces/projects/agent-hub/frontend/src/components/runtime-context/ContextManager.tsx:193). The inspector calls these from its policy/content controls in [ContextInspector.tsx](/srv/workspaces/projects/agent-hub/frontend/src/components/runtime-context/ContextInspector.tsx:87) and [ContextInspector.tsx](/srv/workspaces/projects/agent-hub/frontend/src/components/runtime-context/ContextInspector.tsx:280).

**Preview Gate**
`previewChanges()` posts the draft to `/preview`; `saveChanges()` posts the same draft to `/save` at [ContextManager.tsx](/srv/workspaces/projects/agent-hub/frontend/src/components/runtime-context/ContextManager.tsx:217). The save button is disabled unless there are staged changes, a preview exists, and `preview.delivery.status === 'ok'` at [ContextManager.tsx](/srv/workspaces/projects/agent-hub/frontend/src/components/runtime-context/ContextManager.tsx:1018). This is a client-side gate, not a server nonce; the server still re-runs validation on save.

The frontend API helper maps those calls to `/api/runtime-context/manage/*` at [context-management.ts](/srv/workspaces/projects/agent-hub/frontend/src/lib/api/context-management.ts:125). Backend `/manage/preview` calls `preview_draft()`, and `/manage/save` calls `apply_draft()` then commits at [context_management.py](/srv/workspaces/projects/agent-hub/backend/app/api/context_management.py:40).

**Revision Check**
The server-side source stale check is in `apply_source_edit()`: it locks the source row, compares live `source_revision(row)` to `edit.expected_revision`, and raises HTTP 409 before mutating when they differ at [context_governance.py](/srv/workspaces/projects/agent-hub/backend/app/services/context_governance.py:175). `source_revision()` is `sha256:` plus a semantic hash of `source_snapshot(row)` at [context_policy.py](/srv/workspaces/projects/agent-hub/backend/app/services/context_policy.py:127).

There is also placement stale protection in `apply_draft()`: placement edits compare `draft.expected_placement_revision` with the current `semantic_hash(before_placements)` and raise HTTP 409 if placement rules changed at [context_governance.py](/srv/workspaces/projects/agent-hub/backend/app/services/context_governance.py:267).

Preview uses the real draft application path inside a nested transaction and always rolls it back, so preview exercises the same assembler without persistence at [context_governance.py](/srv/workspaces/projects/agent-hub/backend/app/services/context_governance.py:317). Tests cover the UI preview requirement and original revision payload in [runtime-context-page.test.tsx](/srv/workspaces/projects/agent-hub/frontend/src/__tests__/runtime-context-page.test.tsx:134), stale draft retention after a 409-style error in [runtime-context-page.test.tsx](/srv/workspaces/projects/agent-hub/frontend/src/__tests__/runtime-context-page.test.tsx:172), and stale source rejection before mutation in [test_context_governance.py](/srv/workspaces/projects/agent-hub/backend/tests/services/test_context_governance.py:80).
